save_test_image: create a function that saves a numpy array as a PNG image to a specified filename
compare_imgs: compare two images using perceptual dhash and assert the difference is at most 1 bit
regenerate_test_images: regenerate test truth images by setting REGENERATE_TEST_IMAGES env var and running pytest
review_compare_imgs: review the compare_imgs function to understand how it uses imagehash dhash for visual diffing
test_save_test_image: test the save_test_image function by passing a numpy array and verifying the saved file
